Initial release of video-editor-background.

- Instantly replaces backgrounds in 30-second talking-head videos with AI, producing 1080p exports in under a minute.
- Simple upload-and-describe workflow — no timeline or export settings required.
- Automated cloud setup: acquires token, establishes session, and prepares editing pipeline on first use.
- Supports video uploads, quick background edits, text overlays, aspect ratio changes, state/credit checks, and downloads.
- Includes robust API connection, error handling, and progress updates.
- Accepts most video/audio/image formats up to 500MB; exports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more.
